column1: # Higher health care spending drove 91% of premium growth from 2011 to 2024.

# Source: Cooper (Yale) & Craig (Wisconsin), JAMA Health Forum, September 2026, as reported by Fierce Healthcare and Healthcare Dive. Average premiums rose 78.4% and spending 84.2% over the period; the study is an accounting decomposition and does not show cause.
